styles.label: 1 · Luminous modern
styles.brief: polished modern pixel art with a strong silhouette, broad clustered volume shading, a crisp deep-navy outline, cool cyan rim light, restrained biological accent colors, approximately twelve useful colors, readable on a low-resolution handheld screen

styles.label: 2 · Evolutionary 16-bit
styles.brief: authentic early-1990s 16-bit side-scrolling action-game sprite discipline, chunky one-to-two-pixel dark contour, six-to-eight dominant colors, flat cel-shaded bands, slightly prehistoric shape language, exaggerated readable anatomy, almost no tiny texture

styles.label: 3 · Reef hybrid

styles.label: 4 · AMOLED minimal

shared_constraints: single isolated animal only on a genuinely transparent background, entire silhouette visible with generous canvas safety, crisp opaque pixel edges, strict side view, no scenery, water, bubbles, plants, rocks, prey, shadow, text, label, logo, border, frame, multiple views, sprite sheet, detached particles, cute mascot face, gore, or reference-game character
